name: BC Tech Pilot
eligibilitySummary: British Columbia provincial grant for technology startups to accelerate commercialization of innovative products and services. Supports companies moving from prototype to market-ready with non-repayable funding.

funding.description: Non-repayable grants from $10,000 to $75,000 covering up to 50% of eligible project costs for commercialization activities.

application.applicationRequirements: Must be a BC-based tech company with fewer than 150 employees, less than $20M revenue, and an innovative product or service ready for commercialization. Must demonstrate market validation and growth potential.
